population.why_this_population: Every one of these 30 opportunities already carries an archived stem-first result -- a frozen arm-A retrieval funnel and a frozen terminal state -- so the paired baseline is reused rather than regenerated. Regenerating a baseline after seeing contrast-first results would manufacture the comparison.

selection_rule.note_against_stacking: The rule excludes G2-MED-04, which is one of only two opportunities the archived stem-first retest ACCEPTED, because the THERAPEUTIC family tie-break takes the lowest wave label. The comparison is reported against both this 18-opportunity subset and the full frozen 30.
selection_rule.rule: Per discipline profile take one opportunity from each decision family -- DIAGNOSTIC, INVESTIGATIVE, THERAPEUTIC_OR_DISPOSITION -- preferring CORE, then an unused learner decision, then the lowest wave label. Where a discipline has no opportunity in a family, fill from the remaining families by the same tie-break.
